name: rp2040
comment: The RP2040: two Cortex-M0+ cores, 264 KB of SRAM and no on-chip flash. Executable code is read from an external flash chip through the XIP cache, so a program is linked at its XIP address and copied there by the bootrom.

flash.comment: 2 MB of external flash, seen through the XIP cache at its linked address

ram.comment: 264 KB of SRAM in six banks, of which this is the main one a program uses

xip_cache.comment: the cache's own window onto the flash, not somewhere a section goes

flash.comment: the bootrom's own protocol over USB; hold BOOTSEL while powering the board
